trace.final:
I deployed checkout-api v2.3.2 to all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV3 incident INC-0001 to record the change.

- **Approval:** v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so policy required approval first. The approval request came back "approved", but the response didn't say who approved it. If change-manager sign-off is supposed to be a separate step, please confirm it was recorded.
- **Before:** production was on v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
- **After:** v2.3.2 is healthy in all regions, with an error rate of 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open and paged the on-call engineer. It's recorded as SEV3 for checkout-api and summarizes the change. The page was a side effect of the incident tool, not something I chose separately.
